title: Ashirbad
desc: Brijlal, a cunning entrepreneur, plots to kill his partner and his son. However, the son survives and years later, ends up falling in love with Brijlal's daughter.

title: Mem Saheb
desc: Kajal falls in love with Amit, an unemployed journalist. She urges him to focus on his career and provides unconditional support, but destiny has other plans for the couple.

title: Aakrosh
desc: Two detectives investigate the disappearance of three medical students in a small village, but their search is hampered by corrupt local authorities.

title: Rakhal Raja
desc: Princess Radha is captivated by Ajay's music and falls in love with him. However, Ajay's devoted childhood friend, Phul, selflessly decides to sacrifice her own feelings to unite the pair.

title: Ajker Santan
desc: Chandranath, a factory worker, dies trying to fund his daughter Rani's wedding. After his death, his biological children mistreat his family, while his adopted son Aninda shows true loyalty.
